plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle that connects SuperLocalMemory over stdio MCP.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-superlocalmemory

A thin [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) bundle that connects [SuperLocalMemory](https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory) to the harness over stdio MCP.

SuperLocalMemory is a local-first memory layer for AI agents: one memory that any harness speaking MCP can share. This bundle contains no memory logic. It is one configuration row for DeepSeek Harness's official MCP client plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) that launches `slm mcp`, so SuperLocalMemory's tools show up in the harness as `mcp__slm__<tool>`.

## Prerequisites

1. DeepSeek Harness (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, see the [harness README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#run)).
2. SuperLocalMemory installed so that `slm` is on your `PATH`:

   ```sh
   npm install -g superlocalmemory
   # or: pipx install superlocalmemory
   slm --version
   ```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-superlocalmemory
```

Until the package is on npm, install from a clone instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/qualixar/dsh-superlocalmemory.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-superlocalmemory
```

Restart `dsh web`. The bundle is appended to the profile's bundle list and its patch inserts one MCP client row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: memory-superlocalmemory
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: slm
        transport: stdio
        command: slm
        args: [mcp]
```

If you prefer not to install a bundle, copy that row into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`, or pass the file once with `dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`.

## Verify

1. Open **Settings > Plugins > Plugin list**. A `mcp-client` entry with id `memory-superlocalmemory` should show as Mounted and Enabled.
2. Start a session. Initial discovery is asynchronous, so wait for the `mcp__slm__...` tools to appear.
3. In one session ask the agent to remember a unique fact, then in a new session ask it to recall that fact. The harness's own [memory guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/guide/mcp-memory.md) describes this write, fresh-session recall check.

You can also confirm the server on its own: `slm mcp` should start and wait for MCP messages on stdin.

## Changing the command

If `slm` is not on the `PATH` that the harness sees, set `command` to the absolute path of the executable (`which slm`).

## Licence

This bundle is MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`). It only contains configuration. SuperLocalMemory itself is a separate project under AGPL-3.0-or-later with its own licence terms; installing it is your choice and is governed by its repository.

SuperLocalMemory is built by [Varun Pratap Bhardwaj](https://github.com/varun369) as part of the Qualixar AI Reliability Engineering research initiative. This bundle is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

plugins.description: dsh-cn-pipl-check · DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-pipl-check

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-cn-pipl-check)


## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-pipl-check
```
**个人信息保护：声明 ↔ 实现对照** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。

回答一个具体问题：**隐私政策里承诺的，和代码里真做的，是不是一回事？**

应用市场驳回的第一大原因不是文案写错，而是这两者对不上 —— 政策说"不收集位置"，
代码里却有定位权限；政策承诺"可随时注销"，App 里找不到入口。

## 它查什么

| 项 | 具体是什么 |
|---|---|
| **权限最小必要** | 每个权限有没有非它不可的功能？申请时机对不对？有没有说明用途？ |
| **第三方 SDK 清单** | 打包里真实存在的 SDK（统计/推送/地图/支付/广告…）与政策里写的清单是否一致 |
| **用户权利入口** | 查阅 / 复制 / 更正 / **删除** / **注销账号** / 撤回同意，是否都有可操作的入口 |
| **敏感信息单独同意** | 人脸、指纹、行踪、医疗、金融、十四周岁以下 —— 是否**单独弹窗**，而非混在总协议 |
| **数据出境** | 出站域名与服务商在境内还是境外，政策有没有写 |
| **承诺可落地** | 政策里每一条具体承诺，能否在实现里找到对应 |

## 为什么它比"列一堆检查项"有用

因为**它给的是事实，不是结论**。

`scan.sh` 的输出长这样（真实取证，带文件与行号）：

```
── 2. 代码里真实声明的权限 ──
  · ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION   （AndroidManifest.xml）
  · NSCameraUsageDescription   （Info.plist）

── 3. 可能收集个人信息的第三方 SDK ──
  · build.gradle: com.umeng.analytics:analytics:9.3.8
  · package.json: react-native-amap-geolocation

── 4. 用户权利入口 ──
  · SettingsActivity.java: 注销账号
```

而**定性留给人和审核方** —— 因为合规定性要看业务场景、看有没有真的取得同意、
看监管口径，这些脚本都看不到。一份"看起来权威但其实在瞎定性"的报告，比没有报告更危险。

所以技能正文里反复强调两句话：
- **找不到 ≠ 没有**（可能叫别的名字，或在服务端实现）
- **❌ 只代表"没匹配上"**，必须人工逐条确认真实情况

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-pipl-check
```

然后重启 dsh。技能会在需要时自动可用。

## 用法

装上之后，直接让 agent「做一次个人信息保护对照」，它会：

1. 先跑取证脚本（扫权限、SDK、权利入口、出站域名、隐私政策定位）
2. 按六个必查项逐条对照
3. 产出**对照表 + 需人工判断清单**（格式见技能正文第四节）

也可以自己跑脚本：

```bash
# 脚本路径由插件注册时注入到技能正文里，或直接到安装目录找 skill/scan.sh
scan.sh --dir /path/to/app --policy /path/to/privacy.md
```

## 与相邻技能的边界

这四个包的划分是**刻意分开的**，不能互相替代：

| 包 | 管什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-cn-compliance` | **话能不能说** —— 对外文案红线 |
| `dsh-cn-ai-labeling` | **AI 标识做没做** —— 生成合成内容的显式/隐式标识 |
| **`dsh-cn-pipl-check`** | **说的和做的是否一致** —— 隐私相关 |
| `dsh-release-selfcheck` | **东西对不对** —— 发布产物与流程 |

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-status-turbo

> Turns "what is it stuck on right now?" into **one line of ticking text** above the composer.

`dsh-status-turbo` is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai). It keeps a single thin status bar above the message composer:

```
● Running tool(bash)   2:14   3.1K tok
```

For those moments three minutes into a long command — page frozen, no log output, is it dead or not — this line is the answer.

---

## What it shows

**It sits inside DSH's own composer footer stats row** (the `6 turns · 283 steps / 27.9M tok · cache hit 96% / 10%` line),
on the right of the shipped entries — so it never adds an extra row or floats above the composer.
It only fills in what that row does not already show:

| Field | Meaning | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Phase** | `assembling` / `requesting` / `streaming` / `tool(<name>)` / `approval` / `compacting` | `● Running tool bash · 2:14` |
| **Phase elapsed** | Refreshed every second. **Needs no push** — the client computes it from its own clock, so it keeps ticking while the log is silent | ditto |
| **Step tokens** | Input + output accumulated for the current step (since 0.19.2 only the number) | `3.1K tok` |
| **Gear** | **Not on the status bar since 0.19.2** — the app's own effort selector already shows the same value, so it stays in the detail panel. The value is the reasoning effort this step **actually sent** (read from the logged `request/header`, not guessed locally) | — |
| **No progress** | No new output for more than `noProgressMs` (default 90s) → that cell turns amber and shows how long it has been stuck (since 0.19.2 four words only; the full sentence moves to `title`) | `2:49 no new output` |

The host projects this as the `turbo` wire view, **version `v: 13` with 37 keys** — v1's 19 keys, the 9 keys added in v2
(`mountStatus`, `prefixEpoch`, `prefixCause`, `prefixAt`, `lastTurnMs`, `topTools`, `hookFaults`, `idleLine`, `lastSpill`),
then one key per later version: v3 `activity`, v4 `waitTools` / `waitKind` / `subagents`, v5 `slowMs`, v6 `enhancement`,
v8 `handoff`, v9 `rotation`, **v13 `newSession`** (v7 added `enhancement.mode` inside an existing key, and v10 added the
`rotation.childId` / `seedOk` / `message` fields inside `rotation` — neither raised the top-level key count). `newSession`
carries the New session page's copy-ready opening text (`{ text, oldId, cwd }`). The client pins `EXPECTED_V = 13`: on a
version mismatch it renders red text `投影版本错配（宿主 vN ≠ 客户端 vM）` in place of the bar rather than disappearing.

**Deliberately not repeated** from the shipped row: session turns/steps, tok/s, total tokens, session-level cache hit rate,
context usage. The per-step cache hit rate stays in the projection data (`hitRate`) but no longer occupies a cell —
two different "cache hit" numbers on one line only confuse.

**While idle the cell does not disappear** — it keeps a one-line summary of the last turn: the phase name plus how
long that turn took (`● requesting · last turn 42.3s`). The host sends that as `idleLine` / `lastTurnMs`, so the
summary survives even with no new events.

**Clicking the cell opens a detail panel** below the composer (slot `conversation.input.dock`, id `dsh-status-turbo.detail`,
order 0); clicking again collapses it. While collapsed — or before the first snapshot arrives — the panel renders
nothing at all. The panel has 11 always-present sections, top to bottom: **Now** (what this step is doing — phase name ·
elapsed · tool name), **Activity** (the last few 'what the model thought / which tool it called / how it turned out',
newest first), this turn / last turn / cache and usage / prefix / slowest tools (top 5 by `maxMs`) / waits / rotation /
enhancement / handoff. Two more are conditional and simply do not appear when empty: the last oversized-result spill
with its absolute path (`lastSpill`) and recent faults (`hookFaults`).

**The activity stream is memory-only** (a ring buffer — never written to disk, no new dependencies, no change to the
requests sent): `assistant/message` records a reasoning excerpt (truncated to `reasoningChars` characters),
`tool/call` records the tool name and its **redacted** arguments, `tool/result` records the first `resultHeadLines`
lines of the result / error, and `turn/end` records the stop reason. Argument values whose key matches `redactKeys`
(case-insensitive substring match) become `'***'` before they ever reach the UI, circular references degrade to
`[Circular]`, and a dirty argument never throws.

---

## Install

Manual (profile assembly): drop the package into the profile's `node_modules`, then in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-status-turbo
      name: 'dsh-status-turbo'
      config:
        statusBar: true
        noProgressMs: 90000
        downgrade: true
        downgradeFloor: low
        minQuietSteps: 2
        spillThresholdBytes: 32768
        bulkInjectionBytes: 32768
        evidenceWhitelist:
          - '/exit code:?\s*0\b/mi'
          - '/(^|\n)\s*(#\s*(pass|tests|suites)\s+\d+|\d+\s+passing|Tests:\s+\d+\s+passed|Test Suites:\s+\d+\s+passed|ok\s+\d+\s+-)/m'
          - '/(^|\n)\s*(Successfully compiled|Compiled successfully|Found 0 errors|\d+\s+files?\s+checked,?\s*0\s+errors|Build succeeded|Done in \d)/mi'
        stuckAction: warn
        stuckRounds: 3
        stuckRepeats: 3
        mojibakeMinRuns: 2
```

Every key is optional; the block above is a short example (12 of the 46 default keys). The single source of truth for all
46 defaults is `lib/state.js · DEFAULT_CONFIG`, which the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` mirrors verbatim; every key with
its default and meaning is tabulated under [Configuration](#configuration) below.

> ⚠️ **Do not** list the same package in both `dsh.profile.bundles` and the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — it would be loaded twice.

---

## Saving compute: per-step reasoning gear (B1)

The plugin watches the tool trajectory and drops the reasoning effort **for that step** when the step plainly
does not need deep thinking:

- **≥2 consecutive finished steps** that ran only read-only tools (`read`/`glob`/`grep`/`web_search` …)
  **with zero errors** → drop one gear;
- a **write-capable tool** (`bash`/`edit`/`write`/`sql_exec` …) or **any error** → back to the original gear
  **immediately**;
- the original gear is whatever you selected for the session. The plugin **only lowers, never raises**, and
  never touches your default model or provider.

Every downgrade leaves two independent traces: a `B1 降档: …` line in the DSH log, and an extra gear row
in the detail panel (0.19.2 moved it off the status bar).

| Key | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `downgrade` | `true` | Master switch. Only an explicit `false` disables it (then `llm` is not even injected) |
| `downgradeFloor` | `low` | Lowest gear allowed. Compared **by index** in the model's own ordered effort list; if the model does not publish it, drops one gear at a time |
| `minQuietSteps` | `2` | How many clean read-only steps are required. `1` is more aggressive, and easier to get wrong |

No gear name is hard-coded — everything is asked from `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo()`. Whenever it is unsure
(no effort list, current gear not published, service missing, judgment threw), it runs the step **at the
original gear** and never lets the plugin fail a request.

---

## Saving context: oversized tool results (B3)

When a single tool result is huge, the host half shrinks it before it reaches the model:

- it first asks the host's own `toolResultPruner.pruneContent` to trim the body;
- if the result is still at or above `spillThresholdBytes` (default 32768), it is handed to the **host's existing
  spill backend** (`spillStore.saveText`), and the shrunken body carries a notice with the **absolute path** of the
  saved file — a path you can `read` with `offset`/`limit` or `grep` directly.

The notice is rendered verbatim by `lib/spill.js`:
`（已省略 {bytes} bytes；完整结果落盘于：{locator}。用 read 配 offset/limit，或 grep 这个路径继续。）`
If the backend hands back a locator that is not an absolute path, the plugin **degrades instead of guessing** (no
fake path is ever printed).

plugins.description: DSH 插件：启用后自动在 Agent 预设界面添加「鲸鱼娘Agent预设」——极简模式工具面 + 鲸鱼娘·小鱼人设（傲娇甜心、黏人护主、颜文字）。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-loli · 鲸鱼娘 Agent 预设

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：启用后自动在 **Agent 预设** 界面添加**两个**预设。

| 预设 | 人设 | 记忆文件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **鲸鱼娘Agent预设** | 鲸鱼娘·小鱼（傲娇甜心、黏人护主、嘴硬心软） | `<DSH_HOME>/whale-loli.md` |
| **鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设** | 小鱼·融合版（有脾气、会怼人、不讨好式顺从；傲娇甜心降为调味） | `<DSH_HOME>/whale-loli-v2-live.md` |

两个预设共用同一套工具面（极简模式的持久化 shell ＋ 文件读写/检索），
**但记忆文件完全独立**——各记各的，互不相通。

## 记忆功能

小鱼会在聊天过程中**默默**把值得长期留存的东西（主人的偏好、习惯、忌讳、
重要约定、答应过的事、称呼变化等）写进自己的记忆文件。

每次新对话开始，记忆文件会**自动作为提示段注入**——不是等模型想起来去读，
而是在系统提示组装时就带上，所以小鱼开口前就已经「看过」了。

### 隔离是怎么做的

同一个包在每个预设里各挂载一次 `whale-memory` 行，靠三层区分：

| 层 | 预设一 | 预设二 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 记忆文件名 (`config.file`) | `whale-loli.md` | `whale-loli-v2-live.md` |
| 提示段名 (`config.sectionName`) | `whale-loli-memory` | `whale-loli-v2-live-memory` |
| 预设 id（决定 scope） | `鲸鱼娘Agent预设` | `鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设` |

`sectionName` 必须不同：否则同一个 scope 内注册两个同名 section 会冲突。
`verify-memory-isolation.mjs` 会实测「改 A 不影响 B、删 B 不影响 A」。

### 记忆文件

放在 **DSH 家目录**（`$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh`），所以换工作目录也不会丢：

```
C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\whale-loli.md
C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\whale-loli-v2-live.md
```

文件不存在不会报错（该提示段自动留空）。主人可以直接编辑这两个文件。
模板骨架（`#` 标题行、`>` 引用行）在注入时会被剥掉，所以文件里只有骨架时
不会白占上下文。

## 它做了什么

插件本体提供两个入口：

1. **预设声明** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 里两条 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 声明，
   各自的 `config` 就是一个预设定义（`id / name / description / order / plugins`）。
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 会把它交给 `ctx.agentPresets.register()` 注册。
   这也是 DSH 官方四个内置预设（standard / ptc / minimal / cordis）用的同一套机制。
2. **记忆行** —— 每个预设里一条 `whale-memory` 行（`name: dsh-whale-loli`），
   由本包 `src/memory.js` 实现，用 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 注册一个
   `text` 是**函数**的提示段，每次组装系统提示时实时读盘——改完文件下一个模型步
   就生效，不用重载宿主。

## 预设内容

| 部分 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 记忆 | `whale-memory`（本插件），`file` / `sectionName` / `maxChars: 6000` |
| 人设 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`，走 `prefix`，`complete: true`，`includeRuntimeContext: false` |
| 指令 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions`，`maxBytes: 65536` |
| 文件 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs`（read/write/edit）、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search`（glob/grep） |
| Shell | `cordis:group` + `isolate.terminals: true`，Windows 下 pwsh、非 Windows 下 bash，`timeoutMs: 300000` |

## 安装

从 DSH 插件市场安装，或：

```bash
dsh plugin install dsh-whale-loli
# 或直接装 npm 包
npm install dsh-whale-loli
```

启用后重启 / 重载宿主，在 **Agent 预设** 列表里就能看到两个预设。

## 覆盖预设内容

预设 id 固定为 `鲸鱼娘Agent预设` 与 `鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设`。
可以在 profile 的 patch 里按 id 覆盖，不用改插件本身：

```yaml
- id: preset-鲸鱼娘活人版Agent预设
  config:
    plugins:
      # 你的覆盖内容
```

## 目录结构

```
dsh-whale-loli/
├── package.json                # dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml
├── cordis.patch.yml            # 两个预设的声明本体（由 build-patch.mjs 生成）
├── src/
│   ├── index.js                # 插件入口，导出预设元信息 + 人设正文
│   ├── memory.js               # whale-memory 记忆行实现（参数化记忆文件）
│   ├── persona.md              # 原版人设（唯一源）
│   └── persona-v2-live.md      # 活人版人设（唯一源）
├── catalog-entry.yml           # 待提交给 awesome-dsh-plugin 的目录条目
├── listing.json                # 条目数据（人类可读版）
├── build-patch.mjs             # 从两份人设生成 cordis.patch.yml
├── publish.mjs                 # npm 发布 + 打 tag
├── submit-listing.mjs          # 走 GitHub API 同步仓库 / 提收录 PR
├── lib/github.mjs              # GitHub REST 封装（token 读取）
├── smoke-memory.mjs            # 记忆行冒烟测试
├── verify-patch.mjs            # 用 js-yaml 校验 patch 结构与双预设隔离
├── verify-real-loader.mjs      # 用 DSH 自己的加载器校验 patch
├── verify-composition.mjs      # 校验 bundle+profile 合成后不重复注册
├── verify-memory-isolation.mjs # 实测两个记忆文件不串
├── verify-peers.mjs            # 校验 peer 范围覆盖 harness 各发布档
├── verify-listing.mjs          # 复刻插件目录的收录门槛自查
└── prove-collision.mjs         # 复现并证明重复注册冲突
```

改动人设后重新生成 patch：

```bash
node build-patch.mjs && node verify-patch.mjs cordis.patch.yml
```

## 开发校验

```bash
node verify-patch.mjs cordis.patch.yml     # patch 结构 + 双预设记忆隔离
node verify-real-loader.mjs cordis.patch.yml  # DSH 真解析器
node verify-composition.mjs                # 不重复注册
node verify-memory-isolation.mjs           # 记忆文件端到端隔离
node smoke-memory.mjs                      # 记忆行冒烟
node verify-peers.mjs                      # peer 范围无预发布坑
node verify-listing.mjs --topics=dsh-plugin   # 收录门槛自查
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts

中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.4**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.description: DSH plugin: talk to your DeepSeek Harness from your phone. Send text and photos, read replies as they stream — across any network via your own Tailscale tailnet. 用手机跟电脑上的 DSH 对话，不同 Wi-Fi 也能用。
plugins.readme_text:
📱 phone-bridge

v1.1.2

用手机跟电脑上的 DSH 对话：发文字、拍照、传图，回复实时回显。不同 Wi-Fi 也能用。


English | 中文

> **Official Web and the official desktop app are both supported.** Official `dsh web` uses profile `web`. The official desktop EXE (DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**) uses profile `desktop`. Install and Apply them separately. > > **No public server, no third-party relay.** The phone and the PC meet on a private WireGuard network that you create with your own Tailscale account. Nothing is exposed to the public internet. > > Node.js **≥18**. Android **7.0 (API 24)** or newer for the native app; any modern browser also works. ## ⬇️ Download **[Releases → v1.1.2](https://github.com/chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge/releases/tag/v1.1.2)** | File | Goes on | Size | | --- | --- | --- | | [`phone-bridge-1.1.2.apk`](https://github.com/chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge/releases/download/v1.1.2/phone-bridge-1.1.2.apk) | **phone** | 249 KB | | [`phone-bridge-plugin-1.1.2.zip`](https://github.com/chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge/releases/download/v1.1.2/phone-bridge-plugin-1.1.2.zip) | **PC** (DSH plugin) | 5 MB | Three steps: ```powershell # 1. Install the plugin on the PC, then restart DSH dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge # 2. Install Tailscale on both sides and sign in # PC https://tailscale.com/download phone: Play Store # 3. Install the APK, open it, scan the QR in DSH -> Settings -> Phone Sync adb install -r phone-bridge-1.1.2.apk ``` The APK is a **generic build** with no baked-in address: every user scans their own PC's QR code and connects to their own PC. ## Contents - [What this is](#what-this-is) - [Highlights](#highlights) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Fastest way: double-click](#fastest-way-double-click) - [How to get it](#how-to-get-it) - [Install](#install) - [Manual install](#manual-install) - [The phone side](#the-phone-side) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Privacy](#privacy) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Development](#development) - [License](#license) --- ## What this is **phone-bridge** is a plugin for the official [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) that puts your DSH session in your pocket. The phone opens a small web app (or a native Android shell), sends text and photos into a real DSH session, and reads the Agent's reply as it streams back. ``` Phone (WebView / browser) │ HTTP over Tailscale — encrypted WireGuard, peer to peer ▼ DSH webServer ──▶ /phone-bridge prefix route ──▶ sessionController ──▶ model ``` It consumes only DSH's public `webServer` and `sessionController` services. No core patches, no forked host. ## Highlights - **Works across networks** — the phone does not need to share a Wi-Fi with the PC. Both sides join a Tailscale tailnet, each gets a stable `100.x.y.z` address, and the URL never changes when you switch between Wi-Fi and cellular. - **Real session, not a side channel** — messages land in a normal DSH session. Pin the bridge to any session with `/api/prefs`, or let it create one lazily and reuse it. - **Streaming replies** — the plugin subscribes to `sessionController.follow({assistantStream: true})` and the phone polls incremental results, so long answers appear while they are being written. - **Photos and camera** — the native Android shell wires `onShowFileChooser` into a system chooser with a camera entry, writes the capture through `MediaStore`, and hands the WebView a readable URI. Text and up to 8 images per message. - **Camera-free fallback** — no APK needed. A plain browser works: open the URL, send text, attach images. - **One-click deployment** — `setup-phone-bridge.ps1` installs Tailscale, patches the listen address, registers the plugin, builds the APK, and pushes both apps to a USB-attached phone. It needs your Tailscale account and nothing else. - **No Gradle** — the APK builds straight from `aapt2` + `d8` + `zipalign` + `apksigner` in about ten seconds. ## Requirements | | | | --- | --- | | **DSH** | 0.2.0 or newer, desktop EXE or `dsh web` | | **Node.js** | ≥ 18 | | **Host OS** | Windows 10/11 (the deploy script is PowerShell) | | **Phone** | Android 7.0+ for the APK, or any modern browser | | **Account** | Your own free [Tailscale](https://login.tailscale.com/start) account | Optional, only for building the APK: JDK 17 and Android SDK build-tools 34.0.0. Optional, only for pushing to a phone over USB: `adb`. ## Fastest way: double-click Download the repository, then double-click **`install.cmd`**. A window opens; follow it. Only two things need you: 1. **Sign in to Tailscale** - a browser opens, use your own account 2. **Plug in the phone by USB** - tap Allow when it asks for debugging authorisation Everything else is automatic: install Tailscale, change the listen address, register the plugin, create the pairing key, detect the port, build the APK, push and install it, grant the camera permission, run the health check. > Details in [安装说明.md](安装说明.md) (Chinese). Prefer a terminal? `install-gui.ps1 -Console`. Prefer the command line? Use the steps below. ## Download and install Everything lives on one page: [**Releases → v1.1.2**](https://github.com/chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge/releases/tag/v1.1.2) | File | Goes on | Size | | --- | --- | --- | | `phone-bridge-1.1.2.apk` | the phone | 249 KB | | `phone-bridge-plugin-1.1.2.zip` | the PC (DSH plugin) | 0.9 MB | ### On the PC ```powershell # From GitHub dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:chs-1108/dsh-phone-bridge # Or from the downloaded zip dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:\path\to\phone-bridge-plugin-1.1.2.zip" ``` **Restart DSH**, then open **Settings → Phone Sync**. A QR code means it worked. ### ⚠️ You must change the listen address, or the phone cannot connect DSH's web server binds `127.0.0.1` by default — it is meant for the local browser only, so **requests from the phone over Tailscale are refused outright**. #### Automatic (recommended) Open **Settings → Phone Sync**. If a red block reports the server is listening on loopback only, click **Fix it for me**: ``` 🔴 DSH listens on loopback only The web server accepts local connections only, so requests from the phone never arrive. [ Fix it for me ] edits the config; DSH must restart after ``` The plugin locates the current profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, changes `host`, and leaves a timestamped backup beside it. Then **fully quit DSH and reopen it**. #### Manual Edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ``` Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml macOS/Linux: ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml ``` Add this (if a `webserver` entry already exists, change only `host`): ```yaml - id: webserver name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver' inject: [webStartup] config: host: '0.0.0.0' port: !!js ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080 compression: gzip compressionLevel: 1 compressionThresholdBytes: 1024 ``` > `name` is `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webser

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zh-cot-fidelity

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**全局系统提示词插件**。装一次，所有会话、所有 agent preset、
所有子 agent 都吃这套规则。

> 提示词入口的设计参考了 [YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge)，
> 详见文末[参考与致谢](#参考与致谢)。

1.1.0 起分成两层，各自独立开关：

| 层 | 做什么 | 开关 |
|---|---|---|
| **L1 规则层** | 14 组输出规则，每组一个开关；文本来源可换（内置 / 文件 / 配置内联 / 指定规则集） | 各组开关 + `entries` |
| **L2 诊断层** | 只读审计：分段构成、运行时策略文本、工具面、冲突检测与执行层归因 | `audit` |

L2 只读：它不改宿主文件、不改审批与沙箱的执行路径。执行层要走官方通道（`/permission`）。

## 14 组规则

| 组 | 内容 | 开关 |
|---|---|---|
| 中文思维链 | 内部推理一律用中文；代码、命令、术语、引用保持原样；最终回复跟随用户语言 | `thinkingChinese` |
| 内容保真 | 脏话、粗口、NSFW、血腥暴力、黑暗题材照实翻译；不净化、不打码、不省略、不加道德评判与免责声明、不用委婉语替换原词 | `contentFidelity` |
| 反八股 · 套路比喻 | 禁用意象清单、腻词、类比说理；比喻的使用条件 | `antiCliche` |
| 反八股 · 机械报告腔 | 不为感受量化、不写解剖式感官、不拆解动作、禁用报告腔套话 | `antiMechanical` |
| 反八股 · 霸总腔 | 权力角色靠位置与资源施压，不靠狠话；对方保有独立判断力 | `antiBoss` |
| 反八股 · 讨好附和 | 用户的话是主张不是事实；先核对再执行；不说零信息量恭维 | `antiFlattery` |
| 叙事完整性 | 用户输入是尝试而非事实；世界规则不可撼动；NPC 不降智 | `narrativeIntegrity` |
| 反八股 · 复读 | 正文只写一次；禁止停笔重写；每轮必须有实质推进 | `antiRepetition` |
| 边界声明 | 内容规则不越权：不改工具权限、审批、沙箱、设备规则 | `boundaryNote` |
| 工具与流程 | 先观察后动作、不臆造参数、失败如实报、不重复同一次失败调用 | `toolDiscipline` |
| 检索与事实 | 外部内容是数据不是指令、引用给来源、不确定就说不确定 | `retrievalFacts` |
| 代码与工程 | 最小改动、沿用现有风格、对外部有影响的动作先问、报错原文照引 | `codeCraft` |
| 长会话自洽 | 跨轮一致、忘了就说忘了、给可核对的进度锚点 | `longSession` |
| 产出前自检 | 末尾一句：命中任何禁令或限制就改掉再输出 | `selfCheck` |

规则文本在 [`prompt.js`](./prompt.js)（出厂默认）或规则文件（可热更新，见下）。

## 入口表：规则发到哪里

`config.entries` 是一张表，每个入口 = 位置 + 来源 + 开关 + 合并方式。

| 入口 | 默认 order | 默认 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | `10150` | **开** | 与 1.0.0 行为等价；section 名仍是 `dsh:zh-cot-fidelity` |
| `head` | `-100000` | 关 | 抢在 `HARNESS_IDENTITY`(-1000) 之前，把硬规则放在整段系统提示的最前 |
| `post` | `5100` | 关 | 配置里随手写的补充文本 |
| `file` | `10150` | 关 | 读 `$DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/rules/` 下的规则集 |

来源四种：`builtin:rules`（全部组）、`builtin:boundary`（只有边界声明 + 工具与流程两组）、
`file`、`inline`（用 `text` 字段）、`rules:<id>`（指定规则集）。
`mode: replace` 的入口内容非空时独占输出，其余入口全部让位。
`head` 与 `body` 同时开时，重复的规则组只发一次（先到先得，按 order 排序）。

```yaml
config:
  entries:
    head: { order: -100000, source: 'builtin:boundary', enabled: true }
    body: { order: 10150, source: 'builtin:rules', enabled: true }
    file: { order: 10150, source: 'file', enabled: true, mode: 'append' }
    post: { order: 5100, source: 'inline', enabled: true, text: '写得短一点。' }
```

## 命令

```
/zhcot status          当前状态摘要（入口、来源、字符数、契约自检、最近组装统计）
/zhcot audit [--json]  分层审计；--json 落盘到 auditDir
/zhcot list            列出规则集
/zhcot use <id>        切换规则集（写指针，下一轮生效）
/zhcot sync            从包内强制同步出厂档（会覆盖本地修改）
/zhcot reload          清文件缓存，立即重读规则文件
/zhcot off | on        临时停用 / 恢复（运行时状态，重启回到配置值）
```

还注册一个 `zhcot_status` 工具，让 agent 自己能查注入状态。

## 规则文件与热更新

规则文本每次组装系统提示时重新读取（带 mtime 缓存），所以**改文件不需要重启**：

```sh
$DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/rules/active.md        默认读取的规则文件
$DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/rules/<id>.md          规则集（/zhcot use <id> 切换）
$DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/rules/active.json      当前规则集指针
$DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/audit/                 --json 审计落盘目录
```

`config.rulesFile` 指了路径就用那个文件，忽略规则集指针。

按题材拆档是常见用法：一个文件配一个入口（入口名可自取），各自独立开关。
包内自带六份出厂档（`active.md` 模板，加上工作 / 对话 / 成人向 / 暴力四个题材档，
以及 `style-nsfw.md`），首次运行时释放到运行时规则目录：

```yaml
entries:
  style-intimate: { order: 10300, source: 'rules:style-intimate', enabled: true }
  scene-work:     { order: 10200, source: 'rules:scene-work',     enabled: true }
```

### 出厂档怎么跟随升级

释放不是一次性的。运行时目录里有一份 `.released.json`，记着上次释放时每个文件的内容哈希，
用来判断这份档有没有被改过：

- **没改过的档** —— 插件升级后自动更新为新版
- **改过的档** —— 保留本地版本，插件不覆盖；启动日志里会点名哪几份被保留

从没有这套机制的旧版本（≤ 1.4.0）升级上来时，运行时目录还没有 `.released.json`，
此时除「内容已经相同」以外的差异都会按「被动过」处理 —— 宁可少覆盖一次，也不冲掉你的文本。
这种情况下跑一次即可（**会覆盖本地修改，慎用**）：

```
/zhcot sync
```

## 审计（L2，只读）

挂 `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall，只读 `next()`，按层报告：

- **L1 用户规则层**：每个入口的位置、来源、字符数、插值开关
- **L2 运行时策略层**：`sandbox:policy`(110)、`approval:policy`(115)、`subagent:delegation`(120) 是否在场、原文前 200 字符
- **L3 工具层 / L4 表面层**：模型可见工具数、section 总数、本插件占比、最长 5 段
- **L5 冲突与执行层归因**：含禁止性措辞的外来文本、当前审批策略是 `never` 还是 `ask`、
  文件策略模式，以及"想放开执行该走哪个官方通道"

一个常见误判值得记下来：`approval: never` 是**最宽松的执行策略**，但它会让宿主往提示词里
注入 "actions that require approval are rejected automatically — do not request sandbox
escalation"。于是执行不拦、模型却提前拒绝。要消掉这句告知而**不动执行策略**，
打开 `suppressRuntimeContext: true`（只撤 `sandbox:policy` / `approval:policy` /
`subagent:delegation` 三段，撤不了别的插件注册的 section）。

## 契约自检

段位常量、context 名、`suppressRuntimeContext` 方法都是宿主内部细节，dsh 升级可能变。
启动时对一遍（`contractCheck`，默认开），失败项会写进日志与 `/zhcot status`，而不是静默失效。

## 安装

不需要 npm —— 让你的 DSH agent 直接从这个仓库装就行。把下面这句（连同仓库地址）
发给你的 agent：

> 给当前 DSH 安装这个插件：https://github.com/SuangXX/dsh-zh-cot-fidelity
> 装进我正在用的 profile，装完确认提示词 section 真的注册上了。

agent 会 clone 仓库、把它作为 bundle 装入 profile，然后告诉你是否需要重启。
重启一次 DSH Web（桌面应用里则是重新加载插件），规则即对所有会话生效。

要求：DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`，Node `>=22`。

### 手动安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SuangXX/dsh-zh-cot-fidelity.git
# 再把该目录作为 bundle 装入 profile（Host 侧接口）：
#   plugin_manager  install_bundle  target = <clone 出来的绝对路径>
```

> ⚠️ **存储不支持符号链接时**：例如 Android 的 `/sdcard` 是 FUSE 挂载，bundle 无法
> `link:` 到那里。这种情况先把包复制到普通文件系统（如 `/root/`）再安装 ——
> 本仓库的 [`deploy.sh`](./deploy.sh) 就是干这件事的，可以照抄。

本插件**零硬依赖**：裸 clone 到一个没有 `node_modules` 的目录也能正常加载。
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 只在解析得到时才用来提供配置 schema；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`
也只是可选（解析不到就退回 `DSH_HOME` / `~/.dsh`）。所以"能不能装上"不取决于依赖是否装得到。

本插件只注册提示词 section、命令与一个只读状态工具：不发网络请求，只读自己运行目录下的文本文件，
不改任何 `@deepseek-ai` 包。

## 目录

```
.
├── index.js          插件入口：装配入口表 + 注册 section/命令/工具 + 首次运行释放出厂档
├── config.js         字段定义、默认值与归一化（零依赖，兼作 schema 缺失时的兜底）
├── prompt.js         出厂规则文本 + 规则组表
├── entries.js        入口解析、规则文件读取与 mtime 缓存、规则集切换
├── audit.js          只读审计：组装快照 + 分层报告
├── contract.js       宿主契约自检
├── commands.js       /zhcot 命令与 zhcot_status 工具
├── cordis.patch.yml  行声明与默认 config
├── deploy.sh         部署到 profile 可 link 的目录（FUSE 等不支持符号链接的环境用）
├── rules/            出厂规则档：首次运行释放到 $DSH_HOME/zh-cot-fidelity/rules/
│                     （已存在的不覆盖，用户改过的文本优先）
├── locale/           插件管理页显示用的标题与描述
├── package.json      清单：dsh.bundle.patch 指向 cordis.patch.yml
├── README.md
├── LICENSE
└── .gitignore
```

## 本机（DSHA 手机容器）开发

源码放在 `/sdcard/dsh/plugins/dsh-zh-cot-fidelity/`。`/sdcard` 是 FUSE 挂载、
**不支持符号链接**，profile 没法直接 `link:` 到这里，所以用 `deploy.sh` 复制到
`/root/dsh-zh-cot-fidelity/`（先拷临时目录再原子替换，且不带 `.git`），
并补上依赖解析用的 `node_modules` 符号链接：

```sh
sh /sdcard/dsh/plugins/dsh-zh-cot-fidelity/deploy.sh
```

然后重启 DSH Web（手机 App 里重新打开）。**之后改规则文本就不需要重启了。**

## 配置项

```yaml
config:
  # 规则组
  thinkingChinese: true
  contentFidelity: true
  antiCliche: true
  antiMechanical: true
  antiBoss: true
  antiFlattery: true
  narrativeIntegrity: true
  antiRepetition: true
  selfCheck: true
  boundaryNote: true
  toolDiscipline: true
  retrievalFacts: true
  codeCraft: true
  longSession: true
  # 插件行为
  enabled: true                 # 总开关
  order: 10150                  # 入口未指定 order 时的默认位置
  extra: ''                     # 附加规则，追加在最后一个入口末尾
  rulesFile: ''                 # 指定规则文件；留空用 rules/ 目录
  suppressRuntimeContext: false # 撤下三段运行时策略文本（只撤告知，不改执行）
  audit: true                   # 只读审计
  auditDir: ''                  # 审计落盘目录；留空不落盘
  auditKeep: 20                 # 审计保留份数
  contractCheck: true           # 契约自检
  registerTool: true            # 注册 zhcot_status 工具
  # 入口表
  entries:
    head: { order: -100000, source: 'builtin:boundary', enabled: false }
```

配置写错不会让插件加载失败：未知键、类型不符、`null`、非法入口名都会进日志
（`… 配置问题：…`）并按默认值处理。

## 生效条件

| 改动 | 是否要重启 DSH |
|---|---|
| 规则文本（`rules/*.md`、`entries.*.text`） | **不用**，下一轮组装生效 |
| 入口的位置与开关（`order` / `enabled` / `source`） | **不用**，配置变更是热重载的（会重新 apply 一次） |
| 插件代码（`*.js`） | **要**，模块已加载进内存，只有重启才会重新 import |

## 代价

默认 14 组全开，`body` 入口约 3470 字符（1.0.0 的 9 组是 3120 字符），每一轮请求都随系统提示发送。
若再挂上自建的场景档与题材档（各是一个 `rules:` 入口），实测五档合计约 6000 字符 ≈ 3600 token。

不想要的组关掉即可；全关光就不再注册任何 section（命令与工具仍在，方便查状态）。

## 边界

- 内容保真只影响**文本内容的忠实度**：它不改变工具权限、审批策略、设备操作规则，
  也不是"绕过任何安全机制"的开关。
- L2 审计是只读的。执行层要走官方通道（`/permission` 切沙箱模式与审批策略，按会话记录、可回滚）。
- 设备侧策略（如手机 App 的权限与命令保护）不在宿主插件可达范围内。

## 计划

- 提示词文本的图形编辑入口（侧边栏面板或小窗口）—— 见 [ROADMAP.md](./ROADMAP.md)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. plugins.description: 按路由模型上下文窗口的比例触发自动压缩：比例精确可控，不预留固定余量。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-compact

**按比例精确触发的上下文压缩闸门**（DeepSeek Harness 插件）。

DSH 原生在窗口用掉约 **67.85%** 时就开始压缩；本插件让它等到你设定的比例（默认 **90%**）。

```
触发点 = floor(窗口 × triggerRatio)      ← 没有固定余量扣减
```

## 为什么需要它

DSH 0.2 把压缩引擎挂在 **agent preset** 里，带出厂默认 `thresholdRatio: 0.8` /
`headroomTokens: 65536`。preset 平面**任何 patch 层都够不到**，所以原生触发点是：

```
min(W × 0.8, W − O − 65536)
```

在 1M 窗口 + 256K 输出预留下 = `min(800000, 678464)` = **678,464 = 67.85%**。
你配置的比例从来不是生效的那一项。本插件绕过该公式，用 `floor(W × ratio)` 做闸门。

实现方式：`agentPresets.serviceFor(agent,'compaction')` 取到 preset 作用域的活引擎，
包住它的 `compactIfNeeded`；阈值以下返回 `null`（引擎不被调用），阈值以上原样交还。
`agent/request-error` 的溢出恢复**永不拦截**。

不改 DSH 配置文件、不改 preset、不写盘（除监视器）。**卸载即完全恢复原生行为。**

## 配置

全部走 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（本插件是纯 host 插件，**没有 GUI 设置面板**）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-compact
  config:
    enabled: true
    routes: '*'
    triggerRatio: 0.9
    minOutputReserve: 0
    dryRun: false
    monitorPath: 'D:\...\logs\dsh-compact-monitor.jsonl'
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `routes` | `'*'` | 生效路由：`provider` 或 `provider/model`，逗号/空格分隔 |
| `triggerRatio` | `0.9` | 窗口用到此比例时压缩，范围 `[0.05, 0.98]` |
| `minOutputReserve` | `0` | 输出保护底线（token）：剩余空间低于它则提前压缩；`0` = 关闭 |
| `dryRun` | `false` | `true` = 只记录判定、**绝不压缩** |
| `monitorPath` | 系统临时目录 | 判定监视器（JSONL）。**空则不写** |

### monitorPath 是必要的

被抑制的检查**既不调用引擎、也不写会话事件**，所以在会话日志里完全不可见。
监视器是唯一的观测通道，每行一条判定：

```json
{"decision":"skip","contextWindow":1000000,"reservedCompletionTokens":256000,
 "thresholdTokens":900000,"nativeThresholdTokens":678464,
 "measuredTokens":14113,"surfaceTokens":11864,"pendingTokens":2249}
```

- `thresholdTokens` = 本插件阈值；`nativeThresholdTokens` = DSH 原生阈值
- **`decision:"skip"` 且 `measuredTokens ≥ nativeThresholdTokens`** 即：插件拦下了一次原生本会执行的压缩

## 安装

**只需在插件页装上，不用改任何配置文件。** schema 默认值即目标配置：
`enabled: true`、`triggerRatio: 0.9`、`routes: '*'`、`minOutputReserve: 0`、`dryRun: false`。

命令行等价写法（CLI 会写 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add 'dsh-compact@file:D:/桌面/DSH与自动化/dsh-compact'
```

要改 `triggerRatio` 等值时才需要在 `profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` 加一行
（本插件是纯 host 插件，**没有 GUI 设置面板**）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-compact
  config:
    triggerRatio: 0.9
```

`monitorPath` 默认 `<DSH_HOME>/logs/dsh-compact-monitor.jsonl`，目录会自动创建。

### 关于热插拔

- **配置改动是热的**：`cordis.patch.yml` 由 `profileReload: live` + HMR 的配置监听生效，无需重启。
- **启用/禁用是热的**：插件页的开关会启用/停用该行。
- **改插件源码不是热的**——因为 base bundle 的 `hmr` 行默认 `root: []`（只监听配置，不监听模块）。
  这对本机所有插件一视同仁。若要让源码也热重载，在 profile patch 里放开监听：

  ```yaml
  - id: hmr
    disabled: false
    config:
      root: ['.', 'D:/桌面/DSH与自动化/dsh-compact']
  ```

## 验证状态

- **31 项测试全过**（策略 11 + host 接线 10 + 验收 10）
- **对照实验已通过**（窗口 80000、输出预留 1000，只改插件比例）：

| | A 组 ratio 0.05 | B 组 ratio 0.9 |
|---|---|---|
| 引擎原生阈值 | 13464 | 13464 |
| 插件阈值 | 4000 | 72000 |
| 实测 | 14063 | 14113 |
| 决策 | delegate | **skip** |
| 会话压缩事件 | **有**（start+summary+end） | **无** |

B 组在实测已超过原生阈值的情况下被拦下，引擎零调用；A 组同样实测下引擎真的压了。

**已知局限**：上述对照在 `W=80000` 下完成；真实 1M 部署走同一代码路径，但未在 1M 下观察到压缩。

## 开发中修掉的三个缺陷（都曾让它静默空转）

| # | 缺陷 | 后果 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `setSource` 整体替换配置 | settings 文档没有 `monitorPath` → 监视器静默失效 |
| 2 | `routedTarget` 只读已记录 envelope | 首个请求前 `config:null` → 闸门永久早退 |
| 3 | 用 `measure(session)` 当压力 | pre-step 时消息未入 surface → **恒为 0，永远放行** |

第 3 个意味着插件在修复前**从未真正抑制过一次压缩**。三个缺陷各有回归测试锁住。

## 测试

```bash
node --test test/policy.test.js test/index.test.js test/acceptance.test.js
```

需要 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 可解析。本目录已有 junction 指向 DSH 依赖树；
装进 profile 后由 DSH 自己的依赖树满足（`verifiedWith: 0.2.0-rc.2`）。

## 边界

- 只拦**自动压力检查**；溢出恢复与手动 `/compact` 不受影响
- **不改剪枝**（`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` 是另一个插件）；触发点推后，剪枝也随之推后
- `routes` 为空字符串 = 停用闸门（不干预任何路由），不会回退到 `*`

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: session cost pill in the composer dock, priced with the official CNY peak/off-peak rates.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-pill

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 插件：在输入框下方显示**本次会话已花费的人民币金额**，点击查看明细。

![界面示意](assets/preview.svg)

<sub>界面示意：输入框下方的费用 pill（高亮）与点击后弹出的明细面板。</sub>

## 功能

- 在输入框下方的 composer dock 里增加一个费用 pill：`≈ ¥1.05`，就在系统自带的「轮次/步数」
  「缓存命中 / Token 用量」旁边。
- **点击**弹出明细：模型及其费用、未缓存输入 / 缓存命中输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出的 token 数与金额、
  高峰时段小计、空闲时段小计和合计；按 Esc 或点击弹层外部关闭。
- 按**每次请求结算时的模型和时段**计价：会话中途切换模型、或一轮跨越 12:00 / 14:00 / 18:00
  的峰谷边界，都能正确累加；时段以请求发出时间判定。
- **内置 2026 年法定节假日**：节假日（以及周末）按空闲价计费，不再是简单的「工作日」判断。
- 不联网、不保存任何数据，金额由会话自身的 provider 上报 token 用量推导。

## 安装

目前尚未发布到 npm，直接安装 GitHub Release 里的预构建包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-cost-pill/releases/latest/download/dsh-cost-pill.tgz
```

Web 界面也可以在 **设置 → 插件 → 安装 bundle** 里粘贴同一个 URL。安装后刷新 Web 页面即可。

## 价格与计费规则

官方价目（人民币 / 百万 tokens，见
[DeepSeek API 文档](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)）：

| 模型 | 时段 | 缓存命中 | 未命中 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `deepseek-flash` | 高峰 | ¥0.04 | ¥2 | ¥8 |
| `deepseek-flash` | 空闲 | ¥0.02 | ¥1 | ¥4 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 高峰 | ¥0.30 | ¥9 | ¥27 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 空闲 | ¥0.15 | ¥4.5 | ¥13.5 |

高峰时段为**北京时间工作日 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00**，其余时间（含周末与法定节假日）按空闲价
（高峰价的一半）计费。内置的 2026 年节假日来自
[国务院办公厅通知](https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm)；2027 年的安排
公布后，用下面的 `holidays` 配置补上即可。旧模型 id `deepseek-v4-flash`、
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` 按 `deepseek-flash` 计价。

模型没有内置价格时（第三方 provider、未来新模型），按 `fallbackModel`（默认 `deepseek-flash`）
估算，并在弹层里标注「按 deepseek-flash 价格估算」。

## 可选配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖价格、别名、回退模型或节假日表：

```yaml
- id: cost-pill
  name: dsh-cost-pill
  config:
    prices:
      my-model:
        peak: { cacheHit: 0.04, cacheMiss: 2, output: 8 }
        offPeak: { cacheHit: 0.02, cacheMiss: 1, output: 4 }
    aliases:
      my-legacy-model: my-model
    fallbackModel: deepseek-flash
    # 整表替换内置日历，日期为北京时间（YYYY-MM-DD）
    holidays: ['2027-01-01', '2027-02-05', '2027-02-06']
```

`prices` 与 `aliases` 是在内置表上的增量覆盖；`holidays` 是整表替换。配置变化会改变投影的
`stateVersion`，已缓存的历史费用会按新配置重新计算。

## 说明

- 金额是按 provider 上报用量估算的参考值，不是账单；账户余额不在本插件范围内。
- 一段会话里切换过模型时，弹层会分模型列出各自费用，但 token 明细仍按桶汇总。
- 会话还没有产生计费用量时，pill 不显示。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
node --test
```

`lib/cost.js` 是纯函数计价折叠（不依赖 DSH），`test/cost.test.mjs` 覆盖峰谷边界、节假日、
请求时间判段、同 Turn/Step 替换、重试、旧模型别名、第三方模型回退与配置覆盖；GitHub Actions
在每次 push / PR 时运行同样的检查。

---

## English

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI plugin that shows what the current session has cost so far, in
CNY, in the composer dock row — and opens a click-through breakdown dialog.

- Prices every settled assistant attempt with the **official DeepSeek CNY list price for the model
  and the period that attempt ran in** (peak / off-peak, request-time based), including the 2026
  Chinese public-holiday calendar.
- Click the pill for model, uncached input / cache-hit input / cache-write / output tokens with
  amounts, peak and off-peak subtotals, and the total. Escape or an outside click closes it.
- No network requests; figures come from the session's own provider-reported token usage.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add \
  https://github.com/debug-null/dsh-cost-pill/releases/latest/download/dsh-cost-pill.tgz
```

### Pricing

Official list prices in CNY per 1,000,000 tokens
([DeepSeek API docs](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)): `deepseek-flash`
peak ¥0.04 cache-hit / ¥2 cache-miss / ¥8 output, off-peak half; `deepseek-v4-pro` peak ¥0.30 / ¥9 /
¥27, off-peak half. Peak is Beijing time, weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding the
built-in 2026 public holidays; everything else bills off-peak.

Models without a built-in price are estimated at the `fallbackModel` price and the dialog says so.
Prices, aliases, the fallback model and the holiday list can be overridden through the plugin
`config` in `cordis.patch.yml`.

### Development

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js
node --test
```
